posts.title: Cycle of Lief 13
posts.description: Biking to work on my e-bike is a breeze(literally). Riding acoustic doesn't drastically change my travel time, but it does make me sweat far more than I'm comfortable with if I try (as I have been on my e-bike) to ride to work in my office clothes. Unfortunately, this means risking the chance of my coworkers seeing me in shorts

posts.title: Cycle of Lief 12
posts.description: For whatever reason, I am always shocked and a little alarmed to learn that the people around me pay attention to my routine. Considering how predictable I am, I should not be this surprised.

posts.title: Cycle of Lief 11
posts.description: I am constantly amazed by how recklessly people drive their 2000-pound steel vehicles around residential streets with 25 mph speed limits. This was easily the most avoidable car accident I've ever encountered.
